raw.details:
IDEAForge 2026 – From Problems to Possibilities

IDEAForge 2026 is an online ideathon organized by Visionary Vault Club, NIET and hosted on Unstop. The event aims to encourage students to identify real-world problems and develop innovative, practical, and scalable solutions.

Eligibility

• Open to college/university students from any recognized institution.
• Students from any branch, specialization, or year can participate.
• Inter-college teams are allowed.
• Inter-branch and inter-specialization teams are allowed.
• Participation can be individual or in teams of 2–4 members.

Innovation Tracks

  1. AI & Smart Technology

  2. Social Impact & Sustainability

  3. Smart Campus & Smart City

  4. PetTech & Animal Welfare

  5. Open Innovation

Problem Statements

Participants can choose from the following challenges:

  1. Smart Pet Healthcare & Emergency Assistance

  2. Responsible Pet Adoption & Animal Welfare

  3. AI for Accessibility & Inclusive Education

  4. Smart Waste Management & Sustainability

  5. Student Safety & Emergency Response

  6. Students struggle to identify which campus sustainability problems are most important to users rather than relying on assumptions.

  7. Students need better ways to understand why people do not follow existing waste-segregation practices.

  8. Campus users find some sustainable facilities inconvenient, unclear, or difficult to access.

  9. Existing campus communication about sustainability may not be engaging for students, staff, and visitors.

  10. Students need to test whether a proposed campus improvement actually changes user behaviour.

Participants may also propose an original problem and solution under the Open Innovation track.

Format & Process

Round 1 – Idea Submission

Participants will submit their innovative idea through the Unstop platform.

The submission should clearly explain:
• The problem
• Proposed solution
• Innovation/technology used
• Target users
• Feasibility
• Expected impact

Each team can submit only one idea.

Registration and submission deadline: 27 September 2026, 11:59 PM.

Round 1 Evaluation

Round 1 will be conducted online on 6 October 2026 in the evening.

Shortlisted teams will move to the next round.

Round 2 – Idea Evaluation

Round 2 will be conducted online on 8 October 2026.

Participants may be asked to explain their problem, proposed solution, implementation approach, uniqueness, feasibility, scalability, and expected impact.

Round 2 Results

Results of Round 2 will be announced between 10–15 October 2026.

Shortlisted teams will receive further instructions regarding the final round.

Round 3 – Final Pitch

The final round will be conducted on 23 October 2026.

Teams from nearby cities such as Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram, and other NCR cities will participate offline.

Teams coming from cities far from NCR will participate online.

Finalists will present their ideas before the evaluation panel and may be asked to explain the problem, solution, implementation, uniqueness, scalability, feasibility, and expected impact.

Timeline

Registration Opens: 19 September 2026

Registration & Submission Deadline: 27 September 2026, 11:59 PM

Round 1: 6 October 2026, Evening – Online

Round 2: 8 October 2026 – Online

Round 2 Results: 10–15 October 2026

Round 3 – Final: 23 October 2026

Final Round Mode: Offline for NCR/Nearby teams and Online for teams from farther cities.

Evaluation Criteria

Submissions may be evaluated on:

• Innovation and originality
• Problem relevance
• Practical feasibility
• Technology/implementation approach
• Social or business impact
• Scalability
• Presentation and clarity

Rules

  1. Each participant/team must provide accurate registration details.

  2. A team can have 2–4 members.

  3. Inter-college and inter-branch teams are permitted.

  4. Each team may submit one idea.

  5. Ideas must be original and should not violate intellectual-property rights.

  6. Plagiarism or misrepresentation may result in disqualification.

  7. Participants must submit their work within the specified deadline.

  8. Any form of unfair practice or manipulation of submissions may lead to disqualification.

  9. The organizers reserve the right to verify submissions and eligibility.

  10. The decision of the evaluation panel regarding shortlisted/final submissions will be considered final.

  11. Participants are responsible for ensuring that their submitted content is appropriate, lawful, and their own work.

  12. Organizers may modify the schedule or format if required, with participants informed through official communication.

Official WhatsApp Group – Mandatory

After completing registration, all participants are required to join the official IDEAForge 2026 WhatsApp Group.

The group will be used for important announcements, round-wise updates, shortlist and result updates, final-round instructions, and event-related communication.

Join Official WhatsApp Group:
https://chat.whatsapp.com/JzbWsZZrW3vERey7ns8tAk

Joining the official WhatsApp group after registration is mandatory for all participants.

Organizers

Visionary Vault Club, NIET

Platform: Unstop

Turn Problems into Possibilities. Build. Present. Innovate.
